eps.d: Tom Ballard arrives at Bayview where he becomes a new resident due to his weak willed son and his daughter in law who runs roughshod over her husband. Upon arrival, Tom meets Diana Trent who's main goal in life seems to be to torment the staff of the facility.
Diana discovers she's lost all her money because her investment company has gone bankrupt. Meanwhile, Tom wants to move out of his apartment because it's damp.
Geoffrey's DIY fixation is annoying Tom. Diana is forced to take part in a fashion show after Sarah hurts her ankle.
Mr Kwok teaches the Bayview residents karate. Jane's psychic, Marjorie Evans, agrees to hold a seance to try to contact Tom's late wife.
When Harvey fakes a breakdown and Diana gets the blame, things turn nasty at Bayview retirement home.
Tom is behaving strangely due to a medical problem, but Diana suspects it's because he's seeing another woman.
Diana is elected to represent the elderly at a European conference. Meanwhile, Tom undergoes tests for prostate cancer.
Diana is taken to hospital after collapsing when Tom proposes to her. Jane is still determined to become a nun and is refusing all of Harvey's proposals.
Tom attempts to impress Diana with macho stunts to convince her to marry him. Harvey proposes to Jane.
Tom threatens to go bungee jumping unless Diana agrees to marry him. Harvey and Jane prepare for their wedding.
Tom and Diana are to be married immediately after Harvey and Jane. It's a pity that the minister has booked a funeral into their slot.
